column3: Unique identifier assigned to each row or job record in the combined workforce dataset.
column5: 001; 002; AHIMA001; HIMSS001
column7: Job Descriptions: ID; researcher assigned for AHIMA/HIMSS if needed
column8: Keep unique across datasets. Do not reuse IDs.

column3: Identifies which uploaded spreadsheet or reference source the job record came from.
column5: AHIMA Career Map; HIMSS Job Descriptions; Graduate Database; LinkedIn; Indeed
column7: Researcher assigned from workbook name
column8: Use this to separate career map roles, HIMSS sample roles, and current job postings.

column3: Date the job information or source file was collected or last revised.
column7: AHIMA row 1; HIMSS row 1; researcher assigned for job postings
column8: Use YYYY-MM-DD when available. If only month/year is available, record as text or use the first day of the month and explain in notes.

column3: Plain text URL for the original career map, HIMSS document, or job posting source when available.
column5: https://my.ahima.org/career-mapping/career-map/
column7: AHIMA row 2; HIMSS row 2; job posting source/link if collected
column8: Keep full URL when available for reproducibility.

column3: Website or platform where the job record was found.
column5: Indeed; LinkedIn; AHIMA Career Map; HIMSS Job Descriptions
column7: Job Descriptions: Source; AHIMA/HIMSS researcher assigned
column8: Use original platform name. Do not combine LinkedIn and Indeed into one value.

column3: Exact job title listed in the source spreadsheet or job posting.
column5: Health Information Manager; Application Analyst; Coding Quality Auditor
column7: AHIMA: Job Title; HIMSS: Job Title; Job Descriptions: Job Title/Title
column8: Preserve the original wording from the source.

column3: Alternate job titles, role aliases, or similar names listed for the position.
column5: Systems Analyst; Reporting Analyst; Medical Records Director
column7: AHIMA: Alternate Name; HIMSS: Alternative Names
column8: Separate multiple values with bullets or semicolons. Leave blank if not listed.

column3: Hiring organization associated with a job posting.
column5: Ochsner Health; Houston Methodist; Cotiviti
column7: Job Descriptions: Employer/Company
column8: Use the employer name exactly as listed, then standardize later only if needed.

column3: City, state, region, or remote location listed for the job.
column5: Ferriday, LA; Houston, TX; Remote
column7: Job Descriptions: Location
column8: Keep state abbreviation when available. Use Remote only when location is listed that way.

column3: Indicates whether the position is remote, hybrid, or onsite.
column5: Remote; Hybrid; On Site; Not Specified
column7: Job Descriptions: Work Setting; Location if work setting is embedded there
column8: Use On Site for fully in person roles. Use Not Specified when unclear.

column3: Researcher assigned or source provided career stage for the role.
column5: Entry; Mid; Advanced; Expert; Mid to Upper; Not Specified
column7: HIMSS: Experience Level; Job Descriptions: Career level; AHIMA researcher assigned if needed
column8: Use source value when provided. For AHIMA, assign only if supported by role description.

column3: HIMSS role category that identifies broad role orientation.
column5: Business; Clinical; Technical; Not Applicable; Not Specified
column7: HIMSS: Category; Job Descriptions: Category
column8: Use Not Applicable for AHIMA records unless mapped to HIMSS categories.

column3: Workforce domain assigned using Dr. Beebe's seven domain framework.
column5: Privacy, Risk & Compliance; Data Quality & Population Health; Revenue Cycle Management; Consumer Health Information; Data Analytics; Informatics; Administration
column6: AHIMA, HIMSS, job postings if assigned
column7: AHIMA: Domain (Dr. Beebe); HIMSS: Domain (Dr. Beebe); researcher assigned for job postings
column8: Assign based on the primary responsibilities of the role, not just the job title.

column3: AHIMA career map domain or category associated with the role.
column5: Coding and Revenue Cycle; Informatics; Data Analytics; Information Governance
column7: AHIMA: Domain; Job Descriptions: AHIMA Domain
column8: Use original AHIMA language when listed. If multiple domains apply, separate with bullets.

column3: RHIA exam content domain or domains aligned to the job responsibilities or qualifications.
column5: Data & Information Governance; Compliance with Access, Use & Disclosure of Health Information; Data Analytics & Informatics; Revenue Cycle Management; Management & Leadership
column7: Job Descriptions: AHIMA Domain
column8: Multiple domains are allowed. Use bullets when more than one domain applies.

column3: HIMSS certification domain or skill area aligned to the job responsibilities or qualifications.
column5: Healthcare Information & Systems Management; Strategy, Governance & Organizational Management; Measurement & Improvement; Digital Health Ecosystem
column7: Job Descriptions: HIMSS Domain
column8: Multiple domains are allowed. Use bullets when more than one domain applies.

column3: Degree, diploma, or educational preparation required or preferred for the role.
column5: High school diploma/GED; Associate degree; Bachelor's degree; Master's preferred; Doctoral degree
column7: AHIMA: Education Requirements; HIMSS: Education Requirements; Job Descriptions: Required/Preferred Qualifications when education appears there
column8: Keep required and preferred education separate when possible. Bullet format is recommended.

column3: Minimum qualifications, required skills, credentials, education, or experience for the position.
column5: Required credential; required years of experience; required technical skills
column7: Job Descriptions: Required Qualifications; Qual: Qualification when required
column8: Do not include preferred items unless the posting lists them as required.

column3: Qualifications that are preferred, desired, or a plus but not required.
column5: Master's preferred; healthcare experience preferred; CCS preferred
column7: Job Descriptions: Preferred Qualifications
column8: Anything labeled preferred should be listed separately from required qualifications.

column3: Certification, credential, or license required for the role.
column5: RHIA; RHIT; CCS; CPC; CCA; BLS; Not Specified
column7: Job Descriptions: Credential Required; AHIMA/HIMSS education or qualifications columns
column8: Use Not Specified when no credential is listed. Separate multiple credentials with semicolons.

column3: Certification, credential, or license preferred but not required for the role.
column5: CCS preferred; CHDA preferred; AHIMA ICD-10 Approved Trainer
column7: Job Descriptions: Credential Preferred; AHIMA/HIMSS qualifications columns
column8: Use Not Specified when no preferred credential is listed.

column3: Years of experience or type of prior work experience listed for the role.
column5: 2+ years; 5 years coding experience; prior HIM management experience
column7: AHIMA: Work Requirements; HIMSS: Work Requirements/Qualifications; Job Descriptions: Required/Preferred Qualifications
column8: Extract years separately if later quantitative analysis is needed.

column3: Work experience requirements and job related requirements listed in the source.
column5: SQL experience; EHR proficiency; HIPAA compliance; report writing
column7: AHIMA: Work Requirements; HIMSS: Work Requirements
column8: Remove education requirements from this field if education is already captured separately.

column3: Narrative summary of the role purpose, scope, or overall responsibilities.

column7: AHIMA: Long Description; HIMSS: Long Description
column8: Remove repeated job title wording when cleaned for readability.

column3: Main duties, tasks, or responsibilities listed for the role.

column6: HIMSS and job postings when available
column7: HIMSS: Primary Responsibilities; job postings if collected
column8: Bullet format recommended for readability.

column3: Combined qualifications listed by the source, excluding education when education is already recorded separately.
column5: Technical skills; communication skills; regulatory knowledge; experience requirements
column7: HIMSS: Qualifications; Qual: Qualification
column8: Keep concise but do not remove important requirements.

column8: Optional analysis field. Use only if skills are coded separately.

column3: Communication, teamwork, organization, leadership, or problem solving skills listed for the role.
column5: Communication; collaboration; time management; stakeholder management
column7: Extracted from qualifications and responsibilities
column8: Optional analysis field. Keep original terms when possible.

column8: Use when analyzing emerging skills for workforce readiness.

column3: Salary range, hourly rate, or compensation information if provided.
column7: Job posting source if captured
column8: Use Not Listed when absent. Keep original formatting unless numeric analysis is planned.

column3: Type of employment arrangement listed for the role.

column7: Job posting source if captured
column8: Use standardized values for filtering.
